summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Eagle Point Trinity Senior Secured Lending Co solely to disclose its net asset value per share as of April 30, 2026, which was $10.18. No special-situation transaction—acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, capital return, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change—is announced or implied. The filing contains no deal terms, recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics beyond the NAV disclosure. This is a standard regulatory update that does not constitute a special situation.
